title: Agents
body: Give an agent one key and let each step pick its own model — planning on a frontier model, tool calls on a fast one.

title: Batch pipelines
body: Route a million overnight classifications to whatever is cheapest above your quality floor, with the bill capped in advance.

title: Consumer chat
body: Keep first-token time under 300 ms at peak by spilling over to the next provider before anyone notices.
